name: Side Cart & Upsell for WooCommerce
author: AsanaPlugins

sections.description:
Side Cart & Upsell for WooCommerce turns your default cart into a fast, AJAX-powered Side Cart (Mini Cart) — then fills it with Upsells, Cross-Sells, Product Recommendations, Add-ons, and Order Bumps built to lift your average order value (AOV).

Most free side cart plugins stop at the slide-out drawer and gate upsells, cross-sells, and conditional logic behind a paid upgrade. This one doesn’t. Product Recommendations, Cart & Checkout Upsells, Add-ons, Custom Conditions, and Automatic Discounts are all included free — no coding, no page builder required — and it works with any WooCommerce theme, including block themes and the WooCommerce Store API.

Use flexible conditional logic to personalize offers by user role, cart subtotal, products already in the cart, categories, and purchase behavior — then apply an automatic discount to any recommended or upsell product to make the offer easy to say yes to.

FRONT-END DEMO | BACK-END DEMO | Ask a Question | GET PRO — ONLY €15 FOR THE FIRST 10 BUYERS | Documentation

Features Overview (Free Version)

Video Tutorial

See It In Action

  • Product Recommendations — related products on the product page
  • Product Upsells — a stronger alternative shown before checkout
  • Product Add-ons — accessories and extras on the product page
  • Cart Page Upsell — one more relevant offer before checkout
  • Checkout Upsell — a last-chance AOV boost
  • Product Upsell Popup (PRO) — triggered on Add to Cart

💎 Free Features: Side Cart, Mini Cart, Upsell, Cross-Sell & Add-ons

  • AJAX Side Cart (Mini Cart) — Replace the default WooCommerce cart with a fast, slide-out Side Cart. Includes a floating cart icon and a clean default theme, with no page reload on add, update, or remove.
  • Side Cart Upsells — Show targeted upsell products directly inside the Side Cart before checkout, so every add-to-cart action becomes an AOV opportunity.
  • Product Recommendations — Add personalized recommendations to any product page in a grid or list layout, targeted by product, category, or custom condition.
  • Product Add-ons — Offer accessories, warranties, or complementary items on the product page, in grid or list layout, scoped to specific products or categories.
  • Cart Page Upsells — Add upsell offers directly to the cart page, triggered by cart contents, category, or subtotal.
  • Checkout Page Upsells — Show one final relevant offer on the checkout page before the order is placed.
  • Custom Conditions — Control exactly who sees which offer:
    • Login Status – logged-in vs. guest shoppers
    • User Role – wholesale, VIP, subscriber, and more
    • Products in Cart – show offers based on what’s already there
    • Cart Quantity – trigger by item count
    • Cart Subtotal – set minimum or maximum spend thresholds
  • Automatic Discounts — Apply a fixed amount or percentage discount to any recommended, upsell, or add-on product the moment it’s added to the cart.

🚀 Pro Features: Premium Themes, Popups & Rewards

  • Premium Side Cart Theme (Style 2) — A modern, higher-converting cart drawer layout.
  • Rewards & Milestones Bar — Auto-apply tiered coupons or free shipping as customers hit spend goals, shown live in the Side Cart.
  • Free Shipping Progress Bar — Show shoppers exactly how much more unlocks free shipping.
  • Side Cart Promo Banner — Feature promo codes or flash-sale messages at the top of the cart.
  • Side Cart Stock Countdown — Add urgency with a configurable countdown timer inside the cart.
  • Add-to-Cart Popups — Trigger Upsell popups the instant a customer clicks “Add to Cart.”
  • Proceed-to-Checkout Popups — Trigger Upsell popups from the cart page, right before checkout.
  • Extra Themes & Sizes — More grid/list themes, plus Small/Medium/Large bundle sizing.
  • Product Quick View — Preview any product in a popup without leaving the page.

Limited-Time Launch Offer: Only €15 for the first 10 buyers — Buy Now

sections.installation:
1. Upload the easy-upsells-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install directly from Plugins → Add New by searching “Side Cart & Upsell for WooCommerce.”
  2. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  4. Open the plugin’s settings to enable the Side Cart and create your first Upsell, Cross-Sell, or Add-on.
sections.faq:
Does this side cart work with block themes and the WooCommerce Store API?

Yes. It’s fully compatible with modern block themes and the WooCommerce Store API, alongside classic themes.

Can I customize the Side Cart’s colors, text, and layout?

Yes. Colors, button text, icon position, and cart title can all be styled from the plugin settings without touching code.

Will this slow down my store?

It’s built on lightweight AJAX, so the cart updates without a full page reload, and upsell blocks only load on the pages where you’ve placed them.

Does the Side Cart replace the default WooCommerce cart page?

No. It adds a slide-out drawer alongside your existing cart page, so customers who prefer the full cart page can still use it.

Do I need the Pro version to show upsells, cross-sells, or product add-ons?

No. Product Recommendations, Cart & Checkout Upsells, Add-ons, Custom Conditions, and Automatic Discounts are all included free. Pro adds premium themes, popups, a rewards bar, and a free-shipping progress bar.

Can I target offers to specific user roles or cart totals?

Yes. Custom Conditions let you show or hide any recommendation, upsell, or add-on based on login status, user role, products already in the cart, item count, or cart subtotal.

Does the plugin support automatic discounts on upsell products?

Yes. Set a fixed amount or percentage discount that applies automatically the moment the upsell, recommendation, or add-on is added to the cart.

Is this compatible with Elementor, Divi, and other page builders?

Yes. It works with any theme or page builder — no coding required.

Does it work with variable products?

Yes! Upsells, recommendations, and add-ons support both variable and simple products. All of these selections are fully supported in the Pro Version.

Where can I get support?

Post your question on the support forum and our team will help you directly.
sections.changelog:
1.9.2

  • Fix – Quantity buttons stayed clickable on a product set to “Sold individually”, and on
    a line already at its stock limit. They are now disabled.

1.9.1

  • Feature – Side cart footer updated: totals now match the WooCommerce cart page.
  • Fix – “Invalid offer” error when adding an upsell product to the cart.

1.9.0

  • Feature – New Upsell Theme 3 “Grid carousel”: shows several upsell products at once in
    a scrollable grid, with a “Products per row” setting (2, 3 or 4). Phones always show 2.
  • Feature – Variable products can now be offered as side cart upsells. Previously they
    could be configured but never added to the cart. In Theme 3 the card shows “Select
    options” and opens a full-width variation panel; in Themes 1 and 2 the dropdowns appear
    in the card as before.
  • Feature – Product bundles now appear in the side cart as a single card showing the
    bundle, its price, one quantity control and one remove button, with the bundled items
    listed inside it. Quantity and removal behave the same way they do on the cart page.
    Requires Easy Product Bundles.
  • Fix – Side cart drawer could render completely blank with “Item price” set to “Product
    subtotal”. An internal function was called without being imported.
  • Fix – Side cart drawer could render completely blank when bundled item prices were
    hidden.
  • Fix – Side cart upsell was removed from the cart right after being added when
    “Exclude if in cart” or “Exclude if purchased or in the cart” was selected.
  • Fix – “Invalid offer” error when adding a side cart upsell if another upsell product
    was out of stock or hidden.
  • Fix – Side cart upsell discount was not applied and the product was added at full price.
  • Fix – Side cart did not appear on sites using JS combine or delay features of caching
    plugins.
  • Fix – Compatibility with LiteSpeed Cache, WP Rocket, Perfmatters and Autoptimize for
    deferred JS, delayed JS and unused CSS removal.
  • Fix – Side cart script and style were loaded on pages where the side cart is not
    displayed.
  • Fix – Side cart stylesheet was served without a version number, so browsers and caching
    plugins kept using an old copy after an update.
  • Fix – Side cart did not refresh when the drawer was opened with “Ajax Add To Cart”
    disabled, so it could show the cart as it was at page load.
  • Fix – Cart and Checkout button links can now be left empty and follow WooCommerce’s own
    pages, which keeps them correct on multilingual stores.
  • Fix – Product names containing “&” were displayed as “&”.
  • Fix – Attribute names and options in upsell variation dropdowns containing “&” were
    displayed as “&”, and their “Choose …” label could not be translated.
  • Fix – Footer text in the side cart can now be switched off.
  • Fix – Quantity buttons on upsell cards could be clicked past their minimum and maximum,
    and could not be reached with a keyboard.
  • Fix – Upsell carousel arrows did nothing on wider side cart panels.
  • Fix – Side cart drawer and upsell carousel on iOS Safari: the panel no longer runs
    taller than the screen, and swiping the carousel no longer navigates back.

Note: Help us spread the word by leaving a 5-star review. If something in this release
does not work as you expect, please open a support topic first – we would much rather fix
it for you.

1.8.0

  • Feature: New “Keep Theme’s Icon” mode for the Side Cart — keep your theme’s own cart icon exactly as it is and just open the Side Cart when it’s clicked (no icon replacement, no layout changes). Works on the header and mobile bottom bars.
  • Feature: New “Custom Cart CSS Selector” field so the Side Cart icon works with any theme, even if it isn’t auto-detected.
  • Feature [PRO]: Separate visibility controls for the Floating cart icon and the Navigation/Menu cart icon, on mobile and desktop independently.
  • Improvement: Faster Side Cart, Upsell, and Reviews loading through smarter caching, with the cache refreshing automatically when you save settings or edit a product.
  • Fix: Flatsome cart icon replacement now targets the correct element.
  • Fix: Product-page upsells now re-evaluate correctly after adding or removing items from the cart (no more stale offers).
  • Fix: The custom cart icon now stays in place after AJAX cart updates on both classic and block themes.
  • Fix: Removed a brief flash of the floating cart icon on mobile when it is disabled for mobile.

1.7.1

  • Fixed the CSS z-index issue with the side cart.

1.7.0

  • Major Update: Completely new AJAX Side Cart functionality added!
  • Feature: Fast, responsive AJAX Side Cart (Mini Cart) with a customizable floating trigger icon.
  • Feature: In-cart Upsells & Cross-sells directly inside the Side Cart.
  • Feature [PRO]: Premium Side Cart Theme Layout (Style 2).
  • Feature [PRO]: Gamified Rewards & Milestones Bar (automatically apply tiered discounts or coupons based on cart subtotal goals).
  • Feature [PRO]: Free Shipping Progress Bar to gamify the shopping experience.
  • Feature [PRO]: Promotional Header Banner for the Side Cart (announce flash sales, discount codes, etc.).
  • Feature [PRO]: Stock Countdown Timer to drive urgency at checkout.
  • Improvement: Seamless compatibility with both Classic WooCommerce Hooks and modern Block Themes (Store API).
  • Improvement: Performance optimizations, including parallel API fetching and smart backend object caching to prevent slow load times.
  • Improvement: Compatible with major caching plugins (WP Rocket, Perfmatters, Autoptimize, SG Optimizer).
  • Compatibility with WooCommerce 10.9.4

1.6.1

  • Fixed the theme selection functionality on the Admin side.
  • Compatibility with WooCommerce 10.9.1

1.6.0

  • Fixed checkbox CSS compatibility issues introduced in the latest WordPress release.
  • Compatibility with WooCommerce 10.8.1

1.5.0

  • Fixed a bug in the product recommendation filter options (Pro Version).

1.4.0

  • Fixed an issue with variation product attributes that have a special characters in the attribute name.
  • Compatibility with WooCommerce 10.7.0

1.3.0

  • Added Slider Theme (Pro Version)
  • Compatibility with WooCommerce 10.5.2

1.2.0

  • Fix bugs

1.1.0

  • Add option to display a notification when a product is added to the cart
  • Compatibility with WooCommerce 10.3.5

1.0.4

  • Fixed CSS Product Addons
